visualCharacteristics: Two-column product feature on a dark background: a product screenshot/image beside an eyebrow, heading, paragraph and CTA buttons.
contentPattern: One row, two columns: an image column and a text column (heading, paragraph(s), CTA link(s)). Image can be on either side.

options.name: image-right
options.description: Places the image column on the right (trailing) side instead of the left.

usageDescription: Highlight a product or feature with a supporting image next to descriptive copy and CTAs.
